title: The reduction of a scheme is reduced and a universal homeomorphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $i_X:X_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ its reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. Then $X_{\mathrm{red}}$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme], and $i_X$ is a surjective closed immersion and a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]: for every morphism of schemes $X'\to X$ the base change $X_{\mathrm{red}}\times_XX'\to X'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is a homeomorphism of underlying spaces.
